display.description_zh: 连接企业系统、数据和流程，让AI完成工作，交付结果
examples_en: Find today's high-priority exception orders and create an action list.
Update these policies' latest follow-up results in the business system and return an update summary.
Summarize this month's renewals and claims in a business brief.
Read these renovation acceptance forms, write the details to their project records, and list any issues.
Every day at 9 AM, automatically summarize yesterday's operations and send me a reminder.
Use company policy to check this business application and provide issues and revision suggestions.

识别这些装修验收单，将关键信息写入项目记录，并列出异常项
每天上午 9 点自动汇总昨日经营情况并发送提醒
根据公司制度检查这份业务申请，给出问题和修改建议
